name: Drugs with most side effects
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) RETURN d.name, count(se) AS side_effects ORDER BY side_effects DESC LIMIT 10

name: Most common side effects
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) RETURN se.name, count(d) AS drugs ORDER BY drugs DESC LIMIT 10

name: Drugs sharing a gene target
cypher: MATCH (d1:Drug)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene)<-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]-(d2:Drug) WHERE d1.name = 'Metformin' AND d1 <> d2 RETURN d2.name, g.name LIMIT 10

name: Drugs for a specific indication
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_INDICATION]->(ind:Indication) WHERE ind.name CONTAINS 'Diabetes' RETURN d.name, ind.name LIMIT 10

name: Side effects shared between two drugs
cypher: MATCH (d1:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect)<-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]-(d2:Drug) WHERE d1.name = 'Aspirin' AND d1 <> d2 RETURN d2.name, se.name LIMIT 10

name: Genes targeted by most drugs
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) RETURN g.name, count(d) AS drugs ORDER BY drugs DESC LIMIT 10

name: Drug with both indications and side effects
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_INDICATION]->(ind:Indication) MATCH (d)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) WHERE d.name = 'Bivalirudin' RETURN ind.name, se.name LIMIT 10
